annotations.title: Send a booking offer to a member

description: Send a booking offer to another GigXchange member — the recipient gets a pending booking, a notification and an offer card in Messages, exactly as if the member had sent it in the app. Supported pairs: venue/promoter/organiser to artist, artist to venue/promoter, promoter to venue. Offers involving an agent are app-only. Max 5 offers a day, one per recipient a day, and no duplicate live offer for the same date. Requires the member's "Allow my assistant to act" switch.

event_date.description: Event date, YYYY-MM-DD. Must be today or later.

event_title.description: What the booking is for, e.g. "Friday headline slot" (max 120 chars).

fee.description: The fee offered in GBP (1-100000). Confirm this number with the member before calling.

notes.description: Optional note to the recipient (max 500 chars).

recipient.description: The member being offered the booking, by profile SLUG from a search result (e.g. "jason-and-the-donovans"). A profile id is also accepted.
